examples.title: Artists by track count
examples.sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS Tracks FROM Artist JOIN Album USING (ArtistId) JOIN Track USING (AlbumId) GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY Tracks DESC LIMIT 10;

examples.title: Sales by billing country
examples.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Sales FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Sales DESC LIMIT 10;

examples.title: Customer rentals
examples.sql: SELECT customer_list.name AS customer, rental.rental_date, film.title, staff_list.name AS staff FROM rental JOIN inventory USING (inventory_id) JOIN film USING (film_id) JOIN customer_list ON customer_list.ID = rental.customer_id JOIN staff_list ON staff_list.ID = rental.staff_id ORDER BY rental.rental_date DESC LIMIT 20;

adventureworks.scope: Up to eight initial rows from the question-relevant tables, with all declared foreign-key parent records retained. Other tables may be empty. Aggregates describe this teaching subset only.

examples.title: Orders by customer
examples.sql: SELECT h."SalesOrderNumber", c."CustomerID", h."OrderDate", h."TotalDue" FROM "Sales.SalesOrderHeader" AS h JOIN "Sales.Customer" AS c USING ("CustomerID") ORDER BY h."OrderDate" DESC LIMIT 20;

examples.title: Products on sales orders
examples.sql: SELECT p."Name", d."OrderQty", d."UnitPrice", d."LineTotal" FROM "Sales.SalesOrderDetail" AS d JOIN "Production.Product" AS p USING ("ProductID") ORDER BY d."SalesOrderID", d."SalesOrderDetailID" LIMIT 20;

examples.title: Purchase orders by vendor
examples.sql: SELECT v."Name", h."PurchaseOrderID", h."OrderDate", h."TotalDue" FROM "Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader" AS h JOIN "Purchasing.Vendor" AS v ON v."BusinessEntityID" = h."VendorID" ORDER BY h."OrderDate" DESC LIMIT 20;

examples.title: Inventory by location
examples.sql: SELECT p."Name", l."Name" AS "Location", i."Quantity" FROM "Production.ProductInventory" AS i JOIN "Production.Product" AS p USING ("ProductID") JOIN "Production.Location" AS l USING ("LocationID") ORDER BY p."Name", l."Name" LIMIT 20;
